ui-collarch.technical-specification: A shared UI collection of link-admin-facing components: a link row, and a URL input with inline validation.
ui-collarch.public-surface: link_row/1 and url_input/1 function components, rendered by screen_collarch's own LiveViews.
ui-collarch.private-surface: Internal formatting helpers for a click count and a truncated target URL.
ui-collarch.failure-surface: An invalid target URL renders inline under the input; nothing here ever raises to its caller.
ui-collarch.policies: Every rendered target URL is truncated and escaped before display, never interpolated raw.

subcomponent.name: LinkRow
subcomponent.purpose: Renders one link's short code, target and click count.

owned-invariants.invariant: A retired link's row never renders a working link.
The click count shown always matches the value passed in, never a stale cache.

primary-operations.operation: Render a link's short code and target.

subcomponent.responsibilities: Free prose - a leaf presentational component with no further decomposition.

subcomponent.name: UrlInput
subcomponent.purpose: A text input with inline target-URL validation.

owned-invariants.invariant: An invalid URL is flagged before submit is enabled.
A valid URL never shows a stale error from a prior value.

primary-operations.operation: Validate a URL as the owner types.
Render an inline error for an invalid value.

subcomponent.responsibilities: Free prose - a leaf presentational component with no further decomposition.
